messages:
Incident-Bot: paging: SEV=P1 - elevated TLS handshake failures observed for api.redwood.com across hosted endpoints. Notifying oncall. :rotating_light:
Oncall-Ops: ack. i'm taking it. seeing spike starting ~11:03 UTC in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. customers reporting checksum/tls errors and 502s from the edge.
Alice G: quick check - are we seeing cert errors in the edge logs or connection resets? paste sample please.
Ben K: edge-nginx tail:
```
2026-03-15T11:03:14Z error tls_handshake failed client_ip=52.84.12.101 sni=api.redwood.com cause="tls: handshake failure" alpn="h2"
2026-03-15T11:03:15Z info upstream_reset backend=10.12.9.48:443 reason=connection_reset
```
Carla M: internal service health checks started returning 502s at 11:02:50 UTC. no deploys recorded in the window.
Deploy-Bot: deploy log: none in last 3h. last cert rotation job at 10:29 UTC.
Dmitri R: running a client-level debug with openssl from a bastion into the ALB:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.com:443 -servername api.redwood.com
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = api.redwood.com
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
SSL handshake has read 1183 bytes and written 452 bytes
---
```
Alice G: that verify error indicates a missing intermediate or broken chain. any recent changes to cert pipeline or AMI?
Ben K: rotation job artifacts in S3 show chain.pem only contains the leaf cert. rotation log shows step "assemble-chain" exited nonzero but the job continued (no -e).
Oncall-Ops: hypothesis A: partial chain uploaded during rotation -> many clients fail verify. Mitigation plan: swap ALB listener cert to previous working ARN (arn:aws:acm:prev123). Who can perform immediate swap?
Dmitri R: i'll perform the listener update. applying now, ETA ~45s for propagation across ALB nodes.
Carla M: meanwhile, collect packet captures between edge and origin to rule out MTU/fragmentation or VPC peering issues. i remember similar symptom with middlebox dropping fragments.
Ben K: tcpdump from nat-1 (snippet):
```
11:02:52.010 IP 52.84.12.101.49120 > 10.12.9.48.443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, length 0
11:02:52.012 IP 10.12.9.48.443 > 52.84.12.101.49120: Flags [R], seq 0, win 0, length 0
11:02:52.020 IP 52.84.12.101.49120 > 10.12.9.48.443: Flags [P.], seq 1:400, ack 0, length 399
11:02:52.023 IP 10.12.9.48.443 > 52.84.12.101.49120: Flags [R], seq 0, win 0, length 0
```
Carla M: RST after data suspicious but aligns with TLS verify failure where backend aborts. MTU check: doing ping -M do -s 1400 from edge -> getting fragmentation? running now.
Oncall-Ops: Dmitri status?
Dmitri R: ALB listener switched to previous cert at 11:04:05 UTC. asking for quick health curl.
Alice G: smoke test: `curl -v https://api.redwood.com/health` ->
```
* Connected to api.redwood.com (52.84.12.101) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake complete
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.com
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```
Ben K: external synthetic monitors show error rate dropping back down. looks like mitigation is effective.
CS-Alerts: Received reports from two customers with non-retrying SDKs that saw errors; we've opened support cases and notified them of transient service issue.
Oncall-Ops: marking incident mitigated at 11:06 UTC. hold for 30m monitoring. please start collecting RCA evidence and timeline while warm.
Carla M: immediate root cause tracing: rotation job log indicates assemble chain used CA path `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt`. AMI image baked at 09:58 UTC changed path to `/usr/lib/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt`. rotation script didn't detect missing file and proceeded to upload single-cert chain.pem. ALB accepted it without strong validation.
Ben K: corroborating artifacts: AMI bake PR #482 shows the CA location change. rotation-worker stdout: "assemble-chain: warning: missing intermediates, exit 1" but script ignored and uploaded chain.pem.
Dmitri R: secondary check: VPC peering and route table changes around the time show no flapping; MTU probes returned OK (no fragmentation observed), so we chalk that up as noise. still include as hypothesis in RCA.
Alice G: hypothesis table in-thread:
- H1 (primary): cert rotation worker assembled incomplete chain due to AMI CA path change + silent failure handling -> clients verify fail. Evidence: openssl verify error, chain.pem contents, rotation logs, AMI PR.
- H2 (secondary): middlebox/MTU caused mid-handshake resets. Evidence: tcpdump RSTs, but MTU probe ok. lower confidence.
- H3 (edge config): ALB allowed uploading incomplete chain. Evidence: ALB listener change accepted chain. action: validate before apply.
Oncall-Ops: create follow-ups and assign owners.
Deploy-Bot: created ticket INFRA-3241 assigned to Carla M, Ben K, Dmitri R with labels [incident, tls, cert-rotation].
Ben K: immediate action items from incident:
- Rollback/restore previous cert (done) - Dmitri (closed)
- Add validation step in rotation script: run `openssl verify -CAfile chain.pem leaf.pem` and fail the job if verify fails - Ben (todo)
- Harden rotation job to `set -e` and surface nonzero exits to pager - Carla (todo)
- Audit AMI bake changes & standardize CA path / centralize CA bundle location - Infra team (todo)
- Add ALB pre-apply validation and staging canary - Dmitri (todo)
Carla M: starting the postmortem doc now. including timeline, customer impact summary, root cause analysis, blameless action items, and test plan for rotation job. I'll invite Ben and Dmitri to review.
Oncall-Ops: incident moved to monitoring at 11:36 UTC. final note: approximate client impact ~9% of requests returned TLS verify failures; major SDKs retried and masked, some customers saw errors. please include customer outreach notes in the PM.
Alice G: tech follow-up: add unit/integration tests in rotation CI that simulate missing CA bundle and ensure job fails loudly.
Dmitri R: ops follow-up: add ALB cert validation using openssl prior to changing listener; also add alert for sudden delta in tls_handshake failure rate so we can catch automation regressions quicker.
Ben K: i'll attach all logs (rotation-job logs, AMI PR diff, ALB event history, tcpdumps) to INFRA-3241.
Carla M: drafting RCA headline: "TLS handshake failures due to partial cert chain uploaded by rotation worker after AMI CA path change". will circulate draft.
Incident-Bot: incident_summary created: CERT_ROTATION_PARTIAL_CHAIN_2002234567.
Oncall-Ops: handing off to postmortem owners (Carla/Ben). closing thread.
